articles.summary: UDR, Inc. (NYSE: UDR ), a leading multifamily real estate investment trust, today announced that its Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly dividend on its common stock for the first quarter of 2026 in the amount of $0.435 per share, payable in cash on April 30, 2026 to UDR common stock shareholders of record as of April 15, 2026. articles.title: UDR Declares Quarterly Dividends
